description: This file contains the implementation of the Chosen library, a jQuery and Prototype plugin that enhances select boxes with advanced UI features, including search, grouping, and multi-select capabilities. It defines classes such as AbstractChosen and Chosen, with methods for building, updating, and managing select box interactions.

classes.name: SelectParser
classes.description: Parses HTML select elements into a structured data format for use in the Chosen UI.

classes.name: AbstractChosen
classes.description: Base class implementing core logic for enhancing select elements, including search, selection, and UI updates.

classes.name: Chosen
classes.description: Derived class extending AbstractChosen with additional setup and event handling for full Chosen functionality.

methods.name: set_default_values
methods.description: Initializes default configuration options for the Chosen instance.

methods.name: set_default_text
methods.description: Sets the placeholder or default text for the select box.

methods.name: choice_label
methods.description: Returns the HTML label for a selected item, optionally including group label.

methods.name: results_build
methods.description: Builds the list of options/results displayed in the dropdown.

methods.name: result_add_option
methods.description: Creates HTML for an individual option in the results list.

methods.name: trigger_form_field_change
methods.description: Dispatches input and change events on the original select element.
